{{Quote|As always, your good work is appreciated. When Ansion at last stands outside the Republic and free of its interference, you will receive your just reward. Your unfairly appropriated family estates in Korumdah will be restored to you.|Ogomoor to Kandah|<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>}}
'''Korumdah''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. [[Kandah]]'s family used to own estates there.<ref name="AS" />
